title: 恩佑寺 Enyou Si
subtitle: a temple · outside the walls · confidence A

model.line: Massing only, not a reconstruction: 11 plain blocks (walls, houses, halls), a tinted patch of ground. Its houses, rows and halls are generated to the kind of place, not drawn from a plan of it: assumed (C). The switch `around=0` hides everything outside the walls.

searched: No picture of it found in the catalogues searched for the surroundings.

facts.label: What it was
facts.value: a temple outside the garden walls

facts.label: In 1860
facts.value: burned Oct 1860 (明善's memorial via S1207); the glazed gate survives, district-protected 1981 (S1200 lead)

facts.label: Where
facts.value: osm way 169215123 (恩佑寺山门, surviving gate)

facts.label: Note
facts.value: Built by Yongzheng for Kangxi 'at the east wall of 畅春园' (S05 j76: 建于畅春园之东垣); main hall with three Buddhas. Malone photographs pp.105-106.
